items.title: Execution branch on kylie/feed-profile tip
steps: Confirm Kylie/share-button HEAD equals kylie/feed-profile tip
items.expected: Branch is not ancient main 7ebfbd4; PostActionRow is present.

items.title: Share2 beside comment on friend’s original (Feed)
items.precondition: Signed in as user A; feed shows mutual friend B’s original post
steps: Confirm icon after comment; no Share text label
items.expected: Share2 ghost icon sits on the same row after the comment icon.
items.evidence: 2026-07-30: User confirmed working on localhost:5180 after accepted friendship + test user post visible in feed.

items.title: No Share on own posts
items.precondition: Signed in; you have at least one original post on Feed
steps: Inspect your own post’s action row
items.evidence: 2026-07-30: User screenshots showed Kylie @kylie posts with react+comment only; no Share on own cards.

items.title: Share text post → nested text on feed
items.precondition: Friend has a text-only original post
items.expected: New card: you shared friend’s post; nested embed shows original body text; no image required.
items.evidence: 2026-07-30: User confirmed share flow working on localhost after test @test post appeared in feed.

items.title: Share image post → nested image on feed
items.precondition: Friend has an original post with an image (body optional)
items.expected: Nested embed shows the original image (and body if present).
items.waiver: Session verified text share only; image embed uses same component path — no friend image post exercised in localhost session.

items.title: Share card has no Share control
items.precondition: A shared wrapper card is visible on Feed
steps: Inspect the share wrapper action row
items.expected: No Share2 on the wrapper (no share-of-share in v1).
items.evidence: 2026-07-30: canSharePost hides Share when sharedFromPostId set; user confirmed end-to-end share working.

items.title: Post detail also offers Share on friend’s original
items.precondition: Open /posts/:id for a friend’s original post
steps: Confirm Feed shows the new shared card
items.expected: Detail share works the same as Feed; creates a feed wrapper for the viewer.
items.evidence: 2026-07-30: PostDetailPage wires same onShare/canSharePost as Feed; user confirmed feature working.
items.notes: Detail path not separately screenshot in session; same component + API as Feed.
